title: Access to Relay message, version 1
description: A CloudEvents 1.0 event in structured JSON mode (application/cloudevents+json) that Access posts to Relay for delivery to a person (E42, OP-146 m.4 (b)). `id` is a random UUID and the Idempotency-Key; Relay deduplicates by it. `data` is selected by `type`. `recipient` and the secret fields (`code`, `link`) are never logged by either side.

subject.description: The subject's external id (OP-137), prefix usr_.

device.description: An approver device by its key's RFC 7638 thumbprint; push approvals only.

code.description: Secret: the one-time code. Never logged.

link.description: Secret: the sign-in link. Never logged.

recipient_valid_since.description: Since when the recipient has owned the mailbox; Relay sends it as RFC 7293 Require-Recipient-Valid-Since. E-mail recipients only.

organization.description: Attacker input: rendered as text, never as a link (OP-153 m.3 (o)).

inviter.description: Attacker input: rendered as text, never as a link (OP-153 m.3 (o)).

agent.description: Attacker input: the agent's display name, rendered as text, never as a link (OP-154 m.3 (e)).
Attacker input: the agent's display name, rendered as text, never as a link (OP-154 m.3 (e)).

connection.description: Attacker input: the connected account's name, rendered as text, never as a link (OP-154 m.3 (t)).

client.description: Attacker input: the requesting client's name, rendered as text, never as a link (OP-154 m.3 (p)).

requester.description: Attacker input: who asks for the approval, rendered as text, never as a link (OP-154 m.3 (ff)).

organization.description: Attacker input: the organization's name, rendered as text, never as a link (OP-155 m.3 (i)).

client.description: Attacker input: the requesting client's name, rendered as text, never as a link (OP-155 m.3 (l)).

binding_message.description: Attacker input: the client's binding message for the person to compare, rendered as text; at most 32 characters. The intent itself is never carried (OP-155 m.3 (l)).

upstream.description: Attacker input: the upstream identity provider's name, rendered as text (OP-155 m.3 (h)).

application.description: Attacker input: the application's name, rendered as text; the password is never carried (OP-155 m.3 (n)).

challenge.description: Secret: the challenge id the approver answers. Never logged. The number to match is never carried (OP-156 m.3 (d)).

application.description: Attacker input: the application or client's name, rendered as text.

action.description: Attacker input: what is being approved, rendered as text.

location.description: The coarse location from GeoLookup; absent when unknown, never a placeholder.

intent.description: The intent digest the notice concerns (OP-156 m.3 (c)). Authority never waits on delivery.

name.description: Attacker input: the other Party's or the domain's name, rendered as text.

review_link.description: Secret: the Review link. Never logged.

revoke_link.description: Secret: the Revoke link. Never logged. Absent when nothing is left to revoke.

organization.description: Attacker input: the organization's name, rendered as text.

agent.description: Attacker input: the agent's display name, rendered as text.

grant.description: The Grant that allows the interrupt; Relay checks it live at delivery (E48).

summary.description: Attacker input: what the agent says, rendered as text.

code.description: Secret: the one-time code. Never logged.

relay.message.iys_consent.v1.description: One İYS consent record for Relay to register; never delivered to the person (IDP-37 (4), B23, OP-156 m.3 (c)). Relay reports its registration state to POST /relay/v1/iys-status under this event's id.

channel.description: The commercial message channel; the recipient is the e-mail for email and the phone for sms and call.

source.description: How the person gave or withdrew it.

organization.description: Attacker input: the support organization's name, rendered as text.

case.description: Attacker input: the case as the case system shows it, rendered as text.

scope.description: What the access would allow, rendered as text.

link.description: Secret: the link to the person's own grant page; the operator cannot open it. Never logged. An invitation only (OP-157 m.3 (f)).

operator.description: Attacker input: the operator's display name, rendered as text.

organization.description: Attacker input: the support organization's name, rendered as text.

case.description: Attacker input: the case, rendered as text.

until.description: When the access ends; absent once it has ended or was revoked.

organization.description: Attacker input: the acting organization's name, rendered as text.

incident.description: Attacker input: the incident reference, rendered as text.

alarm.description: Critical: delivered to every on-call Party (OP-157 m.3 (h)).

account.description: Attacker input: the account's or Grant holder's display name, rendered as text.

link.description: Secret: the console link. Never logged.

render.description: The whole canonical render, base64url of its dCBOR; the approver SDK rebuilds it with the Kernel and compares render_digest before it signs H(AAS). CT1 only, to a registered approver device only (OP-157 m.3 (m)).

render_digest.description: The render digest the AAS binds.

campaign.description: Attacker input: the campaign's name, rendered as text.

link.description: Secret: the link to the campaign's view; a view, never a queue. Never logged.
